{{Top}}
'''Loyalists''' were a [[Politics/Legends|political]] faction within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The term was most often used with [[Senator/Legends|senators]], [[Planet/Legends|planets]], or [[Sector/Legends|sectors]], and, more importantly, groups of people who fought against their own kind that supported the Separatist movement. [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] formed a select group of senators to make up the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] during these times. The committee was disbanded with the [[Senate]].
